summary: Genmab A/S, a Danish foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of its amended Articles of Association adopted September 24, 2026. The amendments set share capital at DKK 62,405,855 in DKK 1 shares and renew board authorizations through March 12, 2029 to increase capital by up to DKK 6,600,000, both with and without pre-emption rights, alongside warrant capacity of DKK 750,000. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated; this is a routine governance-charter disclosure, not a special situation.
